name: ASM-020 wearable clasp buckle hinge assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a watch-band style clasp/buckle hinge with rectangular frame, keeper loop, multi-knuckle hinge, latch tongue, strap anchors, and rivets.

tasks.prompt: Create a wearable clasp and buckle hinge assembly for a strap or watch band, including a rectangular buckle frame, keeper loop, multi-knuckle hinge with full pin, folding latch tongue, release tab, strap anchor plates, and repeated rivets. Keep it low-profile and recognizable as a wearable buckle mechanism.
assumptions: Intermediate assembly benchmark targets a compact wearable hardware mechanism with a readable hinge and strap interface.
Repeated components are functional: frame rails, hinge knuckles, rivets, and strap anchors.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
